evals.name: create-custom-table
evals.prompt: Create a custom database table for storing plugin log entries on plugin activation.
evals.expected_output: Use dbDelta() inside activation hook. SQL must have two spaces after PRIMARY KEY, no trailing comma on last field, KEY not INDEX, include {$charset_collate}. Store schema version in option. Check MY_PLUGIN_DB_VERSION before running. Table name uses $wpdb->prefix.

evals.name: add-column-migration
evals.prompt: Add a 'priority' column to my existing plugin table without breaking existing data.
evals.expected_output: Add versioned migration function. Check column exists first via INFORMATION_SCHEMA query. Use ALTER TABLE ADD COLUMN if missing. Bump MY_PLUGIN_DB_VERSION constant. Run migration in init hook via version_compare check against stored db_version option. Idempotent — safe to run twice.

evals.name: fix-dbdelta-not-creating-table
evals.prompt: dbDelta is not creating my table — it just silently does nothing.
evals.expected_output: Diagnose: check for trailing comma on last field, single space after PRIMARY KEY (needs two), using INDEX instead of KEY, missing $charset_collate, or $wpdb->prefix missing. Fix the SQL. Verify by dropping table and re-running. Add error_log($wpdb->last_error) temporarily to surface issues.
